summary.value: Bodega 88 is a casual Upper West Side sports bar at 573 Columbus Ave with a long happy hour, cocktails and Latin-leaning bar food. Restaurantji diners like the energy and the value, praising Delicious food! Great drinks! Awesome atmosphere! and calling happy hour the best window to visit. It is an easy, unfussy stop for a game, a drink or a group snack.

description.value: Bodega 88 is an Upper West Side sports bar at 573 Columbus Ave, New York, NY 10024. It invites guests to join us for Happy Hour Drinks from 11 am - 7 pm. Specials cover beer, sangria and classic mojitos, which makes it an easy casual stop. Restaurantji shows 4.3 262 ratings. Representative Restaurantji praise (diner reviews): “The guacamole is fresh and served with both tortilla and plantain chips”; “Happy Hour is the time to go”. Restaurantji diners also say The service, food and drinks was excellent and describe the place as this gem of a place.

itineraryNote: Bodega 88: an easygoing Upper West Side sports bar; hit Happy Hour is the time to go and order the guacamole with plantain chips.
review1: Diners consistently say happy hour is the best time to visit Bodega 88, when the drinks and snack deals make the bar especially good value.
review2: Fresh guacamole served with both tortilla and plantain chips is the snack most often recommended, and diners treat it as the must-order item.
review3: Atmosphere is a big part of the appeal, with guests describing good food, strong drinks and a fun, lively room that suits a casual night out.
review4: Service is described as friendly and reliable, with families and groups reporting smooth, enjoyable evenings and the food and drinks holding up well alongside the attentive table service.
